source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A dry monophonic retro 8-bit game sound effect. Preserve the reference sound's electronic pitch contour, immediate attack, modulation speed and noise-pulse rhythm. A clearly defined pulse-wave or noise-channel effect, crisp upper-midrange, no muffled low drum or acoustic instrument. Create a variation in synthetic tone color, retaining the same sound gesture. No music, no vocal, no real-world ambience, no reverb. One compact event with immediate attack and short release, no additional impacts or repeated sequence.

mastering.method: preserve reference duration and 25ms-smoothed amplitude gesture; rounded edges; constant active-RMS gain

transient_shaping.method: smooth tanh knee at 2.3 times 25ms local RMS
transient_shaping.reason: generated peak crest would otherwise hide the audible body under the reference peak budget
